name: UpdateServiceNowTableRecord
label: Update ServiceNow Table Record
description: Updates an existing record in a specified ServiceNow table by sys_id using a stored credential.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: The stored ServiceNow credential (Base64 token or OAuth2 token)

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: Name or sys_id of the ServiceNow table (e.g., incident, change_request)

fields.name: RecordId
fields.label: Table Record ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the record to update

fields.name: FieldsToSend
fields.label: Fields to Send
fields.description: List of key-value pairs representing field names and values to update.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API
